program:
app "Daily Quiz" star plum
table question q text, a text, b text, c text, d text, right pick A|B|C|D
state qi num = 0
state score num = 0
let total = count(question)
if qi < total
  "Question" qi + 1 "of" total faint
  each question sort at as x
    if index = qi
      stack gap 1
        x.q head
        button x.a large tap set score = score + if(x.right = A, 1, 0) then set qi = qi + 1
        button x.b large tap set score = score + if(x.right = B, 1, 0) then set qi = qi + 1
        button x.c large tap set score = score + if(x.right = C, 1, 0) then set qi = qi + 1
        button x.d large tap set score = score + if(x.right = D, 1, 0) then set qi = qi + 1
else
  "Your score" score "of" total big
  button "Play again" tap set qi = 0 then set score = 0
form question, "Add question"
describe:
Daily Quiz, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- question: q: text; a: text; b: text; c: text; d: text; right: one of A, B, C, D. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- total is how many question entries.
Remembers while you use it: qi, starting at 0; score, starting at 0.
Shows:
- if qi is less than total:
  - text: "Question", qi plus 1, "of", total.
  - for each question sorted by at:
    - if its position is qi:
      - text: the q of the question.
      - a button the a of the question; a tap sets score to score plus 1 when the right of the question is A, otherwise 0, then sets qi to qi plus 1.
      - a button the b of the question; a tap sets score to score plus 1 when the right of the question is B, otherwise 0, then sets qi to qi plus 1.
      - a button the c of the question; a tap sets score to score plus 1 when the right of the question is C, otherwise 0, then sets qi to qi plus 1.
      - a button the d of the question; a tap sets score to score plus 1 when the right of the question is D, otherwise 0, then sets qi to qi plus 1.
- otherwise:
  - text: "Your score", score, "of", total.
  - a button "Play again"; a tap sets qi to 0, then sets score to 0.
- a form to add a question.
hurried_style: all lowercase, no punctuation, 2 to 8 words
fuller_style: one long sentence of 18 to 30 words
order: start with who it is for
